name: voice-standardized-patient
description: Voice AI standardized patient for clinical interview practice. Two speech pipelines, one page.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "node --watch functions/dev.js" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,functions
